subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission & PO capture for Acme Payments
messages:
From: Laila Khan <laila.khan@acmepayments.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: AP Team <ap@acmepayments.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission & PO capture for Acme Payments

Hi Jonas,

We kicked off vendor setup this morning and I wanted to confirm Redwood's recommended invoice intake for our finance team. Two quick questions:

1) Can we submit invoices via email (ap@redwood-payments.com) as a supported long-term channel, or do you require portal-only ingestion? We have a mix of systems and would prefer to avoid building an SFTP if email is supported.

2) How do you expect multiple POs to be represented on a single invoice? Our upstream ERP can either produce one PDF with several PO lines, or a CSV + PDF pair. I attached a sample CSV of POs for this vendor.

Also: who should we list as the payment entity? Acme Payments has two legal entities in the US — ACME US Holdings and Acme Services LLC. Will that affect routing/payment ledger mapping?

Appreciate any guidance and a minimal example invoice template we can align to.

Thanks,
Laila Khan
Sr. AP Ops
Acme Payments

Attachments: acme_po_list.csv (CSV, 12 rows)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Laila Khan <laila.khan@acmepayments.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission & PO capture for Acme Payments

Hi Laila — thanks for the clear questions and the sample CSV. Short answers up front:

- Email is supported as a long-term ingestion channel, but we recommend using the portal as the primary path for high-volume suppliers. Email works fine if you agree on subject tokens and the minimal template.
- For multiple POs on one invoice we prefer either: (A) a single PDF with clearly labeled PO lines plus an attached CSV that maps line->PO, or (B) a single canonical CSV (line-items) plus PDF for signature/terms. We'll accept both but CSV + PDF helps automated matching.

Practical guidance and ask:
- If using email, please set Subject: Redwood-PO: <VendorName> <subject-token> and include the account id in the first line of the email body (we will provide an onboarding token).
- For payment entity, we need the exact legal name as it appears on invoices to map to our payment ledger. Please confirm which entity will be the invoice issuer (ACME US Holdings or Acme Services LLC). The choice affects the GL mapping but not the intake channel.

I'm looping in Vanessa from onboarding — she'll share the compact CSV schema and a short onboarding checklist.

Next step: Vanessa will send the minimal invoice CSV template and the onboarding form link; Laila, if you can confirm the legal entity and preferred channel (portal or email) we'll finalize the mapping.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Vendor Enablement Lead
Redwood Inference

(Attachment referenced: example-invoice.pdf)
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Laila Khan <laila.khan@acmepayments.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission & PO capture for Acme Payments

Hi Laila — forwarding the compact template and a short checklist. See below and the Drive link.

Compact invoice CSV schema (minimum fields):
- invoice_number (string)
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- total_amount (decimal)
- currency (USD)
- line_number (int)
- po_number (string)
- line_description (string)
- line_amount (decimal)
- tax_amount (decimal)
- remit_legal_name (string)   <-- this is important for ledger mapping

Email ingestion guidelines (if you choose email):
- To: ap@redwood-payments.com
- Subject: Redwood-ONBOARD <onboard-token>
- Body first line: remit_legal_name: <legal entity>
- Attachments: preferred CSV + PDF (CSV is machine-readable; PDF is for human/audit)
- Max combined attachment size: 25MB
- Example file names we recommend: 'ACME_INV_20250901.pdf' and 'ACME_LINES_20250901.csv'

Onboarding checklist:
1) Confirm remit_legal_name
2) Provide tax ID (W-9 or W-8 as needed)
3) Upload sample invoice + CSV for a one-off validation run
4) Confirm payment SLA and bank remittance details in the onboarding form

Drive link (sample files & onboarding form): https://drive.google.com/open?id=onboarding-form-ACME

If you prefer portal-only we can enable an account and share a secure upload link — portal provides idempotency and quicker reconciliation. If email, we'll set up an 'email-token' to attach to your vendor record.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Program Manager, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference
From: Laila Khan <laila.khan@acmepayments.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission & PO capture for Acme Payments

Thanks, Vanessa and Jonas — that helps. A couple follow-ups after I reviewed the schema and tried a sample export from our ERP: 

- We'll use Acme Services LLC as the remit_legal_name for all invoices to Redwood.
- Our ERP can output the CSV like your schema; I'll attach a test CSV + a representative consolidated PDF to validate matching.
- Can you confirm how we should handle invoices where a PO is split across multiple lines with different tax treatments? Should each tax line be a separate CSV row with the same po_number?

Attaching: acme_po_list.csv, test-invoice.pdf

Best,
Laila

Attachments: acme_po_list.csv (CSV, sample), test-invoice.pdf (PDF, consolidated)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Laila Khan <laila.khan@acmepayments.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission & PO capture for Acme Payments

Hi Laila — perfect, thanks for confirming Acme Services LLC. Quick answers on tax-split lines and next steps: 

- Tax/split lines: please include one CSV row per accounting line. If a PO is split by tax treatment, include multiple rows with the same po_number and different line_number values. That makes automated aggregation and tax calculation deterministic.

- Validation: we'll run the sample you attached through our ingestion sandbox and report any mapping issues within 24 hours. If everything looks good we'll:
   1) Provision your email-token for ap@redwood-payments.com (if you choose email) OR enable a portal account (if you choose portal).
   2) Add the remit_legal_name mapping to the vendor record so payments route to the correct ledger.

Would you prefer us to provision the portal account now (portal link and idempotency roll-out), or do you want to validate one more sample over email first? Either path works; portal gives fewer reconciliation exceptions for recurring billing.

Thanks — I'll kick off the sandbox run now and loop back with the validation report.

Jonas Weber
Vendor Enablement Lead
Redwood Inference
